_provenance: Schema-derived fixture — Cycle 2 RED. Represents the shape of an SEC EDGAR companyfacts API response (https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000320193.json for AAPL). A real captured fixture is produced by the opt-in live test (--include-live). The implementer must produce this shape from a live SEC EDGAR fetch. Values here are test sentinels — NOT hardcoded producer outputs.

_api_requirements.user_agent_header: REQUIRED — e.g. 'AlphaBotPM research@example.com'. Missing UA is the primary cause of SEC 403s.

_note: companyfacts JSON has: entityName, cik, facts.us-gaap.<ConceptName>.units.<unit>[{accn, cik, entityName, loc, end, val, form, filed, frame}]. The producer must extract key financial concepts (Revenues, NetIncomeLoss, Assets, Liabilities) and produce a fundamentals payload + sources = SEC filing links.

Revenues.label: Revenue
Revenues.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process.

Assets.label: Assets
Assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized.

companyconcept_shape._note: Used by _build_fundamentals_section for targeted per-concept fetches
